patch_workspaces_webhooks_token:
  operationId: generateNewWebhookToken
  summary: Generate a new token for a webhook subscription
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-233258-patch.workspaces.webhooks.token-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    Our spec: PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/webhooks/{webhookId}/token.
    Official spec candidate: PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/webhooks/{webhookId}/generateNewToken.
    Live probe: GET /webhooks/{id}/token → 405 'Request method GET is not supported'
    (path IS registered in Spring-MVC, only method wrong).
    Live probe: GET /webhooks/{id}/generateNewToken → 404 'No static resource' (path
    does NOT exist in Spring-MVC routing table).
    Conclusion: /token is the correct live path. /generateNewToken is absent.
    LIVE-OVERRIDE: official spec (if it says /generateNewToken) is wrong.
    Our spec path /token is confirmed by 405 discrimination.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - in: path
      name: workspaceId
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - in: path
      name: webhookId
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: New webhook token generated
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            description: New token details
    '405':
      description: Method not allowed (GET not supported; use PATCH)
endpoints.notes: Critical path discrimination: /token returns 405 on GET (path exists), /generateNewToken returns 404 Spring 'No static resource' (path absent). Our spec path /token is the correct live endpoint. LIVE-OVERRIDE.

patch_workspaces_time_off_requests_status:
  operationId: updateTimeOffRequestStatus
  summary: Update time off request approval status via policy-scoped path
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-233258-patch.workspaces.time-off.requests.status-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    Our spec lists PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/requests/{requestId}/status.
    This path appears only in our raw_allowlist_gen.go (line 148) — no typed tool
    implements it. The actual live paths used are:
      - PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId}
        (used by approveTimeOff, denyTimeOff, updateTimeOffRequest — all three typed tools)
    Live happy-path probe: created a time-off request under policy <redacted-id:1e975578e3>,
    approved it via clockify_time_off_approve → status=APPROVED confirmed (HTTP 200).
    The approve/deny/update typed tools all hit /policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId}.
    LIVE-OVERRIDE: the correct live path is the policy-scoped variant. The /status
    sub-path is not used by any live tool and may not exist at all (not probed directly
    since raw-writes are disabled). Our raw allowlist should prefer the policy-scoped
    path as the canonical truth.
    Cleanup note: the approved request <redacted-id:01eb976817> could not be deleted
    ('Approved time off requests cannot be withdrawn' — expected Clockify behavior;
    sacrificial workspace entity).
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - in: path
      name: workspaceId
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - in: path
      name: policyId
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
      description: Required in the actual live path (policy-scoped variant)
    - in: path
      name: requestId
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [status]
          properties:
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [APPROVED, REJECTED]
            note:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Time-off request status updated
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              status: {type: string}
              policyId: {type: string}
              requestId: {type: string}
              policy:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id: {type: string}
                  name: {type: string}
endpoints.notes: Live happy-path confirms PATCH /policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId} is the real endpoint. Our spec path /requests/{requestId}/status exists only in the raw_allowlist and is not exercised by any typed tool. LIVE-OVERRIDE: canonical path is policy-scoped.
